requirements.summary: Add login UI, session persistence, and role-based UI guards for Admin vs Staff, including admin-only management screens.
acceptanceCriteria: User can log in with username/password and remain authenticated across page refresh.
System supports at least roles: Admin and Staff (or equivalent), with UI and backend authorization checks.
Admin-only actions are blocked for non-admin users in both UI (hidden/disabled) and backend (rejected calls).
Initial admin credentials exist as specified and can be changed by an admin from Settings.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell that wires authentication state, protected routing, and shared layout. Include role-aware route guards so admin-only screens are inaccessible for non-admin users.

Implement a frontend auth/session context that supports username/password login UX, persists auth state across refresh (e.g., localStorage), and exposes current role for UI guarding. Use the selected authorization component concepts (role-based access control) at the UI layer; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add reusable route guards: RequireAuth (blocks unauthenticated users) and RequireAdmin (blocks non-admin users), rendering an access-denied screen when needed. Use selected authorization component patterns for access-denied UX; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a username/password login screen matching the requested credentials flow, including error states and a logout action. Ensure post-login navigation returns to the dashboard.
Create a simple access denied component used by guards for unauthorized access attempts, with guidance to contact an admin.

requirements.summary: Build top navbar with required dropdowns and wire the full page/route structure, protected behind authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Navbar renders consistently across authenticated pages.
Register dropdown contains Vendor, Customer, User screens.
Inventory dropdown contains Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Book, Ledger screens.
Invoice, Reports, and Settings are accessible as their own sections.
Routes are protected so unauthenticated users cannot access app pages.

file_operations.description: Add routing dependency (e.g., react-router-dom) and any required UI helper dependencies for navigation and dropdown composition.

Define all required routes for Dashboard, Register (Vendor/Customer/User), Inventory (Inventory/Sales/Purchase/Order Book/Ledger), Invoice, Reports, and Settings. Wrap routes with RequireAuth/RequireAdmin as appropriate to enforce protection.
Create a shared authenticated layout that renders the top navbar and the main content area consistently across all authenticated pages.

Implement the top navigation bar with the specified sections and dropdowns. Compose shadcn-ui components (e.g., NavigationMenu/DropdownMenu/Button) without modifying frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire AppRouter into the App shell and ensure unauthenticated users are routed to LoginPage while authenticated users see the AppLayout + navbar.

requirements.summary: Create Vendor and Customer management screens under Register with add/list/search and deletion UI.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create a vendor with required identity/contact fields and see it in a searchable/sortable list.
User can create a customer with required identity/contact fields and see it in a searchable/sortable list.
User can delete vendors/customers with confirmation, and deleted entities no longer appear in lists.
Backend persists vendors/customers and enforces authorization.

file_operations.description: Create Vendor management UI: add vendor form, searchable/sortable list, and delete-with-confirmation flow. Compose shadcn-ui form/table/dialog components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create Customer management UI using backendInterface customer capabilities (addCustomer/getAllCustomers/updateCustomer/deleteCustomer) for listing and mutations, including search/sort and delete confirmation. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for customer list and mutations, including optimistic UI handling where appropriate and graceful error handling for authorization failures.

requirements.summary: Create admin-only User management screen to create/list/assign roles and delete/disable users, hidden for non-admins.
acceptanceCriteria: Only admin can create/update/delete/disable users.
Admin can assign a role/permission set per user.
Non-admin users cannot access user management UI or perform user management backend calls.
Disabled users cannot log in.

file_operations.description: Create an admin-only User Management UI under Register > User. Provide create user, role assignment, list users, and disable/delete actions with confirmations. Use RequireAdmin guard and hide the nav item for non-admins. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a hook to fetch and cache the caller role/admin status (e.g., via getCallerUserRole/isCallerAdmin) and expose it to navbar and guards, handling unauthorized states cleanly.
Hide/disable Register > User entry for non-admins and ensure the Settings entry is also admin-only where required.

requirements.summary: Implement Inventory item management UI with add/edit/delete and stock-related metadata visibility (arrival/sold dates per transaction).
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory items support at least: item code, item name, and current quantity on hand.
System records stock-in (arrival/purchase) date and stock-out (sale) date at the transaction level (not just a single date per item).
User can add/edit/delete items (with safeguards if item has historical transactions).
Low inventory can be derived from quantity and a configurable low-stock threshold per item or global default.

file_operations.description: Create Inventory management UI backed by backendInterface product capabilities (getAllProducts/addProduct/updateProduct/deleteProduct/searchProducts). Include add/edit dialogs, delete confirmation, and list/table with search and sort. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for products list/search and mutations (create/update/delete), plus utility to derive low-stock state based on thresholds.

Add UI for configuring low-stock thresholds (global default and/or per-item) and surfacing them to the inventory list and dashboard. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Purchase entry UI under Inventory > Purchase with vendor selection and line items, updating inventory quantities via backend capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create a purchase record selecting a vendor and adding one or more line items with quantities and cost.
Submitting a purchase increases inventory quantities accordingly.
Purchase records are listed and filterable by date/vendor/item.
Backend persists purchases and inventory changes atomically.

file_operations.description: Create Purchase entry UI with vendor selector, purchase date, and multi-line item editor (product, qty, cost). Provide a purchases list with filters. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable line-items editor component used by purchase and sales forms to add/remove product rows and compute totals. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Sales entry UI under Inventory > Sales with customer selection, delivery person, payment status (paid/unpaid/partial), and red highlight for pending.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create a sale record selecting a customer and adding one or more line items with quantities and selling prices.
Submitting a sale decreases inventory quantities accordingly and records sale date.
Sale can be marked as paid/unpaid/partial with paid amount and due amount computed and stored.
Unpaid/partial entries are visually highlighted in red in relevant lists and have a clear “Pending” status label.

file_operations.description: Create Sales entry UI with customer selector, sale date, delivery person name, multi-line items with selling prices, and payment status editor (paid/unpaid/partial) with computed due amount. Ensure pending items are highlighted in red. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a consistent status badge component used in Sales/Order Book/Ledger lists that visually emphasizes pending/unpaid states (red highlight) per design requirement. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Order Book table showing sold items/orders with filtering/search and payment status highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: Order Book lists sales/orders in a table with required columns (items/qty/date/delivery person/price/payment status).
User can filter by date range, customer, and payment status.
Entries with pending payment are highlighted in red.
Order Book is backed by persisted sales/order data (not just UI state).

file_operations.description: Create Order Book UI backed by stored order/sales data (use backendInterface getAllOrders/getOrder where available). Render a table with required columns and filters (date range, customer, payment status) and red highlight for pending. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for orders list/detail and mutations used by Order Book and related drill-down navigation, with filter helpers and empty-state handling.

requirements.summary: Implement Ledger derived from Order Book/Sales with running balance and final positive/negative balance, emphasizing pending payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Ledger is derived from sales/orders without duplicate manual entry.
Ledger shows per-customer (or overall) outstanding amounts and running balance depending on filters.
Ledger view includes a final balance (positive/negative) at the bottom.
Pending/unpaid amounts are clearly labeled and visually emphasized.

file_operations.description: Create Ledger UI that derives entries from orders/sales data and computes running totals and final balance. Include filters (customer/date/status) and emphasize pending items. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add pure utility functions to derive ledger rows, compute running balances, and summarize totals from fetched order/sales data for reuse in Ledger and Reports.

requirements.summary: Build dashboard with sales chart, pending payments list, and low-inventory widget sourced from backend data.
acceptanceCriteria: Sales chart renders from stored sales data and supports at least a daily view over the recent period (e.g., last 30 days).
Pending payments card lists each pending entry with name and due amount; clicking an entry navigates to its detail (sale/order/ledger).
Low inventory card lists items below threshold with remaining quantity.
All widgets load from backend data and handle empty states gracefully.

file_operations.description: Add a lightweight charting dependency (or implement with SVG) suitable for a simple sales chart, plus any required date utility dependency.

Create dashboard page with three widgets: sales chart (daily last ~30 days), pending payments list (click-through to detail), and low-inventory list (below threshold). Use backend-derived data via hooks and render empty/error states gracefully. Compose shadcn-ui Card/Table components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement the sales chart widget with a clean, minimal style consistent with the theme. Compose shadcn-ui card primitives; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement pending payments widget listing name and due amount with red emphasis for pending and navigation to relevant detail views. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement low-inventory widget listing items below threshold with remaining quantity and clear emphasis styling. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement invoice view with print-ready A5 layout and correct firm details and alignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoice screen allows selecting/creating an invoice from an order/sale and displays a print-ready A5 layout.
Invoice includes all specified fields and firm contact block exactly as provided.
Line items show item code, item name, qty, and pricing totals.
Layout is visually aligned and readable when printed to A5 (CSS print styles).

file_operations.description: Create invoice screen that can load an invoice derived from an order/sale and renders a print-ready A5 layout. Include required fields (item code/name/qty/date/delivery person/delivered-to) and the firm details block exactly as specified.

Create a dedicated A5 invoice component responsible for consistent alignment, typography, and totals layout to match an 'original invoice' feel. Compose shadcn-ui primitives where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add print-specific styles to ensure A5 sizing, margins, and aligned rendering when printing/downloading. Keep styling consistent with the white/black theme.

requirements.summary: Enable invoice download as an A5 PDF with deterministic filename.
acceptanceCriteria: User can click a “Download PDF” action on an invoice.
Downloaded PDF uses A5 dimensions and matches the on-screen invoice formatting closely.
Downloaded filename includes invoice number and date (or another deterministic identifier).

file_operations.description: Add PDF generation dependencies (e.g., jspdf + html2canvas or equivalent) required to export the invoice view to an A5-sized PDF.
Implement a utility that captures the rendered invoice and generates an A5 PDF file with a deterministic filename, handling font scaling and pagination safeguards as needed.
Add a “Download PDF” action that uses the PDF utility to export the currently viewed invoice, and ensure error/disabled states are handled gracefully.

requirements.summary: Show Paytm UPI QR code on invoices encoding an exact-amount UPI payment request, with admin-only prompt if missing configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Invoice view displays a QR code for payment.
QR code encodes a UPI payment link/request including the exact invoice total amount.
If UPI payment configuration is missing, UI shows a clear admin-only prompt to configure it in Settings (without breaking invoice rendering).

file_operations.description: Add a QR code rendering dependency (e.g., qrcode / react-qr-code) to display a scannable UPI payment QR on invoices.
Add a utility to generate a standards-compatible UPI payment URI that includes payee parameters and the exact invoice total amount.

Create a component that renders a QR code for the generated UPI URI and shows an admin-only configuration prompt if required settings are missing. Compose shadcn-ui components for callouts/dialogs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire InvoicePaymentQR into the invoice layout, ensuring it never breaks invoice rendering when configuration is missing.

requirements.summary: Implement admin-only Settings section to manage user credentials and core business/payment settings including UPI/Paytm QR configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page is accessible only to admins (non-admins cannot view or call related backend methods).
Admin can change a user’s username and/or password.
Admin can configure the UPI/Paytm QR payment parameters used to generate invoice QR codes.
Settings changes persist and take effect without redeploying.

file_operations.description: Create an admin-only Settings page with sections for user credential management and business/payment configuration (UPI/Paytm QR parameters). Compose shadcn-ui Tabs/Form components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a form to edit UPI/Paytm QR configuration used by invoice QR generation, including validation and save feedback. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create admin-only UI to change user IDs/passwords and manage user status (disable/enable) as required, with confirmations and clear warnings. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure Settings routes are wrapped in RequireAdmin and that non-admin navigation cannot reach Settings.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent premium white/black theme with restrained accents and clear red emphasis for pending/unpaid and alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent white/black dominant theme with restrained accent colors.
Tables, forms, and dashboard cards are readable and visually consistent.
Pending payments and alerts (e.g., low stock) use clear, accessible emphasis (including red highlight for unpaid).

file_operations.description: Add global styles and CSS variables to enforce the white/black premium theme across the app, aligning with Tailwind/shadcn conventions and ensuring accessible contrast.
Tune Tailwind theme tokens (colors/radius/shadows) as needed to match a minimal premium aesthetic while keeping restrained accent colors.
Ensure consistent page spacing, background, typography, and card/table styling across all pages using shared layout structure.

requirements.summary: Implement Reports section with daily/monthly sales summary, profit/loss, and GST tax reporting computed from stored purchase and sales data.
acceptanceCriteria: Reports page provides daily and monthly sales totals over selectable date ranges.
Profit/Loss report calculates revenue minus cost of goods sold based on recorded selling prices and purchase costs.
Tax report supports GST totals based on configured per-item (or per-line) GST rates and summarizes taxable value and GST amount over a date range.
All reports are derived from persisted purchases/sales and match underlying records when cross-checked.

file_operations.description: Create Reports page with sections/tabs for sales summary, profit/loss, and tax (GST if applicable), including date range controls and tables/cards for results. Compose shadcn-ui Tabs/Date inputs/Table components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add utilities to compute daily/monthly totals, profit/loss (revenue minus cost), and GST summaries from fetched purchase/sales/order data and configured GST rates.

Create a reusable report filter bar (date range, grouping daily/monthly, optional customer/vendor/product filters) used across report views. Compose shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
